definition.simple: The profit left for the owners after every cost, interest and tax has been paid.
definition.balanced: Earnings (net income) = revenue − cost of sales − operating expenses − interest − tax. It is the last line of the [[income-statement]]. Earnings are an accounting figure: they can differ a lot from the cash the business actually collected, so compare them with [[cash-flow]].

example: Revenue 1,040, all costs, interest and tax 926: earnings = 114 (fictional, millions USD).
